extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from existing packet mechanism notes plus primary XML sections.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TPF and des-Phe1 TPF show source-supported S. aureus membrane permeabilization in the SYTOX uptake assay; W-des-Phe1 TPF and dW-des-Phe1 TPF remain weaker in that assay.
direct_assay_types: SYTOX Green uptake membrane permeability assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantitative time-course values are not tabulated locally; the claim is limited to source-supported relative/qualitative permeabilization.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Antibiofilm effects are source-supported phenotypic activity; the paper frames them as similar to bacteria-killing/membrane-disruption behavior rather than a quorum-sensing-specific mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TPF, des-Phe1 TPF, W-des-Phe1 TPF, dW-des-Phe1 TPF
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct quorum-sensing assay is promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aggregation and peptide assembly are source-supported context for reduced antimicrobial performance of Trp/D-Trp analogs, with MD/contact-map evidence and turbidity assays treated as mechanism context rather than direct antimicrobial target proof.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD simulation and aggregation observations do not by themselves establish a direct cellular killing mechanism.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local article text and Figure 9 caption support qualitative hemolysis trends, but no local source-data table or machine-readable exact bar heights are available for the database exact hemolysis percentages.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact DBAASP hemolysis percentages are preserved as source_conflict rows; final toxicity evidence uses qualitative primary-source rows only.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The locally available supplement is a PDF with sequence/MS/chromatogram/yield figures and no recovered activity/toxicity tables.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No activity/toxicity values are added from the supplement; primary XML Tables 3 and 4 remain the gate-changing activity source.
